properties._html:
Fishing Vessel, Wilmington, NC

2012-11-13
USCG Sector North Carolina notified NOAA SSC at 12:30 pm EST on November 13, 2012 about a fishing vessel on fire with 800 gallons of diesel fuel on board. USCG requested trajectory information.
